D: Maverick returns to train a group of young pilots for a near-impossible mission.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone heads to the Hard Deck bar.
S: Corn chips baked with black beans, cheddar and jalapeños, guacamole and salsa
Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, finished with pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream.
the dogfight football game on the beach

Franks charred over coals in toasted buns, smothered in quick beef chilli, melted cheddar, buttery onions and yellow mustard. Brown 300g beef mince with a diced onion, add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 15 minutes. Cook a sliced onion in 20g butter until soft. Grill 8 franks over coals until blistered. Toast 8 buns, add the franks, spoon over chilli, top with 120g grated cheddar and the onions, and finish with mustard.
Hard Deck bacon cheese loaded fries
Crisp fries topped with melted cheddar and crisp bacon

Crisp fries smothered in melted cheddar and crispy bacon, finished with sour cream, pickled jalapeno and chives. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C until crisp. Fry 4 diced rashers bacon until crisp. Top the fries with 150g grated cheddar and bacon, grill 2 minutes to melt and finish with 150g sour cream, sliced pickled jalapeno and chives.
M: Butterflied prawns grilled in garlic chili butter, with cos and cucumber salad
Green prawns butterflied and grilled with garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley butter, a crisp salad of cos and cucumber, and crusty bread to mop up the butter, eaten out on deck.
Maverick's old friend Hondo and the crew before the mission

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, baked low and slow, lacquered with smoky bourbon barbecue glaze and charred, with crunchy pickle slaw. Mix 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp bourbon and 1 tbsp honey for 3 minutes. Brush on and grill hot for 5 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage with chopped pickles, 3 tbsp mayo and a splash of pickle juice.
W: Toasted marshmallows with salted caramel between sweet cookies

Marshmallows toasted over the fire until molten, squashed with milk chocolate and a smear of salted caramel between crisp sweet biscuits. Toast 16 marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden. Spread 16 plain sweet biscuits with a little thick caramel and a pinch of sea salt. Sandwich each marshmallow with a square of milk chocolate between 2 biscuits and squash together.
K: Bourbon shaken with muddled lemon, mint and sugar syrup, over ice

Bourbon muddled with lemon wedges, mint and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint crown. For each drink, muddle half a lemon cut into wedges with 15ml sugar syrup and 6 mint leaves in a shaker. Add 60ml bourbon and ice and shake hard. Pour everything into a tumbler, top with crushed ice and add a big sprig of mint.
